description: Side panel listing PDF annotation threads with per-thread comment detail, reply, resolve/reopen, delete, a thread filter (TmPdfThreadFilter, phase 12: the All | Unresolved segmented control), and a composer for commenting on the current text selection. Used internally by TmPdfViewer when annotations are enabled.

parameters.name: SelectedThreadIdChanged
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the selected thread id changes.

parameters.name: CurrentUserId
parameters.description: Current user id used for mention styling and permission checks.

parameters.name: ShowResolvedChanged
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the resolved filter toggles.

parameters.name: PendingSelection
parameters.description: Pending text selection awaiting a new comment, when present.

parameters.name: ShowChrome
parameters.description: Whether the panel renders its own header (title + close). Default true - the docked desktop presentation. When the panel is hosted inside a responsive sheet (TmSidePanel), the sheet header owns the title and the close button, so the host passes false and the panel renders only the resolved filter and its body.

parameters.name: OnCreateThreadRequested
parameters.description: Callback invoked with the body of a new thread requested from the pending selection.

parameters.name: OnReplyRequested
parameters.description: Callback invoked when a reply is requested.

parameters.name: OnEditRequested
parameters.description: Callback invoked when an existing comment body is edited.

parameters.name: OnResolveRequested
parameters.description: Callback invoked when resolving a thread is requested.

parameters.name: OnReopenRequested
parameters.description: Callback invoked when reopening a thread is requested.

parameters.name: OnDeleteRequested
parameters.description: Callback invoked when deleting a comment is requested.

parameters.name: OnSelectionDismissed
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the pending selection is dismissed.

parameters.name: OnCloseRequested
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the panel's close button is pressed.
